caption: The video captures a close-up of a white plastic pump dispenser, its ribbed collar and threaded shaft visible beneath a lever nozzle that a hand grips from above with thumb and forefinger. A viscous, translucent-white liquid is already emerging from the nozzle tip as the excerpt opens, hanging as a thin vertical thread against the blurred pale basin behind. The hand holds the pump steady while the stream evolves on its own. A rounded bead swells at the tip and the flow thickens into a wobbling strand that falls out of frame. Partway through, the strand bulges again at the nozzle before stretching downward once more. This heavy flow then thins and largely breaks, leaving a short dangling thread. As the clip continues, the discharge settles back into a thin, mostly steady vertical thread with minor thickness wobbles. Throughout, the lever and the gripping fingers remain at nearly the same height, and the liquid simply drains from the open nozzle.
